scope: Authored SELECT queries and manually specified results for fictional local in-memory SQLite only; not observed model outputs or production instructions

queries.name: inner_pairs
queries.sql: SELECT t.task_id,t.team,e.event_id,e.kind FROM tasks t INNER JOIN events e ON t.task_id=e.task_id ORDER BY t.task_id,e.event_id

queries.name: left_pairs
queries.sql: SELECT t.task_id,t.team,e.event_id,e.kind FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN events e ON t.task_id=e.task_id ORDER BY t.task_id,e.event_id

queries.name: where_done
queries.sql: SELECT t.task_id,e.event_id FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN events e ON t.task_id=e.task_id WHERE e.kind='done' ORDER BY t.task_id,e.event_id

queries.name: on_done
queries.sql: SELECT t.task_id,e.event_id FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN events e ON t.task_id=e.task_id AND e.kind='done' ORDER BY t.task_id,e.event_id

queries.name: left_counts
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT(*),COUNT(e.event_id),COUNT(DISTINCT t.task_id) FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN events e ON t.task_id=e.task_id

queries.name: team_counts
queries.sql: SELECT t.team,COUNT(*),COUNT(e.event_id),COUNT(DISTINCT t.task_id) FROM tasks t LEFT JOIN events e ON t.task_id=e.task_id GROUP BY t.team ORDER BY t.team

queries.name: distinct_inner_tasks
queries.sql: SELECT DISTINCT t.task_id FROM tasks t INNER JOIN events e ON t.task_id=e.task_id ORDER BY t.task_id

queries.name: unmatched_event_references
queries.sql: SELECT e.event_id,e.task_id FROM events e LEFT JOIN tasks t ON e.task_id=t.task_id WHERE t.task_id IS NULL ORDER BY e.event_id
